newsitem.title: USA: Silgan unit issues $300 mln in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Silgan unit issues $300 mln in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A high-yield debt issue from Silgan Holdings Inc's Silgan Corp was priced on Tuesday via Morgan Stanley & Co, according to a syndicate source.
The issue was increased in size by $150 million, market sources added.
TYPE SNR SUB DEBS ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 12/01/97 LAST MOODY'S B1 YIELD 9.00 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
